event_data.context:
## Problem

Upgrading the installed Development System plugin changes the absolute paths used to launch its Model Context Protocol (MCP) services. Today, the setup preview treats that path refresh as a complete repository reconfiguration. Users must reselect commands and approve scopes, features, model roles, and other settings that are already current and were not requested to change.

## Desired outcome

Provide a narrowly scoped upgrade operation that distinguishes repository configuration from version-qualified MCP executable rebinding. When the schema-v3 repository configuration is semantically unchanged, report it as unchanged, require approval only for the old-to-new executable path changes, leave the Development System configuration file untouched, and preserve all unrelated project-local Codex configuration byte-for-byte. If repository settings would change, retain the existing full preview, command-selection, and explicit-confirmation workflow.

This makes routine plugin upgrades accurately reflect the change users are authorizing while preserving the existing safeguards for real configuration changes.

## Implementation notes

- Compare the current schema-v3 repository configuration semantically with the proposed configuration.
- Separate repository configuration changes from Development System-owned MCP-binding changes in preview output.
- For a path-only upgrade, preview only the old and new absolute executable paths and require confirmation only for that mutation.
- Applying a path-only preview must update only Development System-owned entries in `.codex/config.toml`; do not rewrite `.development-system.toml` when its semantic contents are unchanged.
- Bind confirmation to an immutable preview hash so approval cannot authorize a different release, executable path, or repository configuration.
- Fail closed when target binaries are missing, not executable, identify themselves as incompatible components, or do not belong to the requested plugin release.
- Update the setup skill documentation to explain the distinction between repository configuration and version-qualified MCP binary rebinding.
- Run the repository-required continuous integration and final-review protocol.
event_data.summary: When an installed Development System release changes only its executable locations, show and approve only those path changes instead of asking users to reconfirm unchanged repository settings.
event_data.title: Make plugin upgrades ask approval only for changed executable paths
